subject: design/maintenance-sweep-v1
statement: All sweep policy lives in **one** closed-parse file — schema version, the staleness bound, package waivers, plan waivers — homed in the repository's policy directory and located through **one new `paths.*` configuration key**, the same pattern the merge lane's risk policy landed (#D-3). Every waiver entry requires a reason; a reasonless entry refuses to load (prd FR-10 · UB-2). Unknown keys are errors (the closed-parse house rule). The concrete file grammar and key name are the shape's.
